purpose: Make the Story Dossier act as the canonical intelligence object before clustering, writing, repair, image selection, and publication.

implemented.effect: Multi-event source items are split into event-segment source records before event clustering so one mixed feed item cannot contaminate a canonical dossier.
Actor, action, object, time, location, consequence, and status now carry confidence, source IDs, independent source count, and evidence status.
Raw claims, normalized claims, corroborated facts, disputed facts, contextual facts, and prohibited inferences are separated before Writer Reasoning.

Cluster readiness now measures actor consistency, action compatibility, timeline compatibility, object/consequence consistency, semantic similarity, contradiction severity, and competing event centers.
Downstream systems can reference the exact locked dossier revision used for Writer, Headline, Image, Editor, Newsletter, Creator Desk, and Publisher work.
The Writer receives allowed fact IDs, required attributions, prohibited claims, known unknowns, paragraph plan, no-generic-fallback policy, and sentence-to-fact mapping requirements before drafting.
The reusable dossier subsystem now exposes event segmentation, claim graph construction, evidence-backed event signatures, coherence diagnostics, and revision hashing.

learning.avoidanceRule: Do not allow a source roundup or mixed source document to enter event clustering as one story. Segment first, then cluster canonical events.
learning.repairRule: If a dossier lacks evidence or has competing event centers, route it back to evidence/dossier expansion instead of drafting generic prose.
learning.writerRule: The Writer consumes the locked dossier contract and may not draft a standard or deep article without allowed fact IDs and attribution requirements.

verification.dossierModuleLoad: require('./framework/dossier') exposes segmentSourceEvents, buildClaimGraph, and hashDossierRevision
